title: Sized too big to fit in the Arctic Air we ordered at the same time.
text: Sized too big to fit in the Arctic Air we ordered at the same time.. I ordered this when I ordered Arctic Air during the heat wave, but after we soaked it and froze it to insert, we realized that it did not fit the arctic air machine that we ordered. It is too wide to fit in the slot on our machine!

product_metadata.title: Ontel AAUF-MC12/4 Arctic Air Ultra Filter, 1 Count (Pack of 1), Blue
features: Replacement Air Filter: Keep your cooler clean and longer lasting with this replacement filter made of sponge material to trap dust and other impurities; Compatible with the Arctic Air Ultra Evaporative Air Cooler
Purifies While It Cools: Coating on this air purifier filter ensures durability while keeping your personal space cleaner; The BPA free filter is good with hard water
The replacement humidifier filter for the tabletop air purifier cooler takes hot and dry air to make it cool, moist and comfortable; replace every 3 to 6 months
Easy Installation: Use the filter drawer tab to pull out the filter drawer, then place the new filter in drawer in marked location and close filter drawer
For Best Results: Lightly pre soak new filter under cold, running water; For even more cooling power, place a wet filter in the freezer until frozen
description: Arctic air Ultra replacement filters are made from a sponge material. No more wasteful paper filters! The filters are washable and reusable. It is recommended to replace the filter every 3-6 months for best use. For use with Arctic air Ultra (not included). how to replace filter: use the filter drawer tab to pull out the filter drawer & remove filter. Place filter in drawer in marked location, and close filter drawer. For best results: lightly pre-soak new filter under cold, running water. For even more cooling power, place a wet filter in the freezer until frozen.
